# Dinner Options for 4 in Mexico City

A casual, vegetarian-friendly dinner for 4 with a **1,800 MXN** food budget is workable at all three places, but the best fit depends on how important vegetarian variety and spice control are.

# Ranked Restaurant Comparison

| Restaurant | Suitability for Group | Expected Value | Spicy-Food Friendliness | Best Fit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Restaurant A: Mexican street food | High | Very strong | Mixed; many items may be spicy unless customized | Best overall for vegetarian variety and value |
| Restaurant B: Italian pasta and pizza | High | Strong | Very good; easiest to avoid spice | Best for the person avoiding spicy food |
| Restaurant C: Japanese ramen | Medium | Fair to strong | Good if the vegetarian broth is mild, but options are limited | Best only if the group wants ramen specifically |

## Best Choice by Priority

**Restaurant A** is the best overall choice for the group if you want the most vegetarian options and the strongest value under budget.
**Restaurant B** is the safest choice if one person avoids spicy food and you want the lowest-risk casual dinner.
**Restaurant C** is the weakest fit for this group because it has only one vegetarian broth option, which limits flexibility.

### Restaurant A: Mexican street food
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Group fit:** Very good for a casual dinner; street-food style is relaxed and easy to share.
- **Vegetarian fit:** Excellent, since it has many vegetarian tacos.
- **Budget fit:** Likely the best value for 4 people within **1,800 MXN**.
- **Spice factor:** Can be managed, but sauces and salsas may need to be skipped or requested on the side.

### Restaurant B: Italian pasta and pizza
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Group fit:** Very good for casual dining and shared ordering.
- **Vegetarian fit:** Good, with two vegetarian mains.
- **Budget fit:** Usually solid for a group of 4, though portions and drinks can push cost upward.
- **Spice factor:** Best option for the person avoiding spicy food.

### Restaurant C: Japanese ramen
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Group fit:** Good if everyone wants ramen, but less flexible.
- **Vegetarian fit:** Limited, with only one vegetarian broth option.
- **Budget fit:** Probably acceptable, but value is weaker because choices are narrower.
- **Spice factor:** Likely manageable if the vegetarian broth is mild, but customization may be limited.
